Subject: StratoCare vendor activation — initial evidence pack and kickoff

Hi Connor,

Thanks for taking this. We're starting vendor activation for Redwood as part of our telehealth integration (StratoCare Opportunity STR-452). To move to PO and procurement, our security and finance teams need a short evidence package up front:

- SOC 2 report (latest full report or SOC2 Type II attestation)
- ISO 27001 certificate (if available)
- Penetration test attestation or letter confirming latest test date and scope
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached stub)

Can you confirm an owner on your side and an estimated timeline for providing these items? We aim to have procurement paperwork (PO) routed the week of May 17 if we have the evidence ready.

Attachments: vendor_attestation_form.pdf (please return completed)

Thanks,

Subject: Re: StratoCare vendor activation — pen test scope & retention queries

Janelle — quick security follow-up on the pen-test-letter-2026.pdf you uploaded: can you confirm the pen test scope covered external and internal network assessments AND application-layer testing for the API endpoints we will be using? Our minimal acceptance criteria:

- External network vulnerability scan + targeted web app pen test
- Confirmation of CVE remediation windows and whether critical findings were retested
- Pen test report date and tester name/company (we need a signed attestation)
- Data retention requirements: do you require logs to be retained beyond 365 days for audit? We typically provide 90/365 options depending on contract.

If you can reply with a short note confirming those bullets we can accept the pen test attestation and proceed with legal review.
